# Buying a home to renovate in Cefalù and the Madonie: what to check first

You may like a home for its location or space, yet there are still important aspects to clarify before buying. To assess a renovation, separate the documents, physical conditions, and the feasibility of your desired transformations. This guide helps you prepare your questions; it does not replace checks by a notary or the professionals you appoint.

## Summary

- Documents to gather before committing
- Cadastre and building regularity: different types of verification
- Building conditions and constraints
- From project to estimate
- Frequently asked questions

## Gather documents, not just photographs

Ask which proof of ownership (atti di provenienza), floor plans, title searches (visure), building permits (titoli edilizi), and subsequent filings are available. Also collect documentation on utilities and any certificates of occupancy (agibilità), to be evaluated case-by-case. For a property in a condominium, ask for information on common areas and any approved works. This is a preparatory list, not a certification that every document is always required in the same way.

The Italian Revenue Agency (Agenzia delle Entrate) guide distinguishes between cadastral and mortgage checks before purchase. This information does not replace a technical examination of the state of the property or a notary's analysis of rights and deeds.

## Cadastral and urban planning compliance are not synonymous

The cadastral floor plan is used to represent the property within the land registry system; it is not, by itself, sufficient to prove that all construction works were carried out legally. A professional must compare the surveyed state with the building documentation and reconstruct the legitimate status according to applicable regulations. The national reference is Article 9-bis of Presidential Decree (D.P.R.) 380/2001, to be interpreted within the Sicilian framework.

If discrepancies emerge, do not assume that updating the cadastre is sufficient or that regularization is definitely possible. Ask which checks are missing, who will carry them out, and how any uncertainty impacts your decisions before signing commitments. Any contractual protections must be defined with your notary or a qualified consultant.

## Assessing the building, installations, and desired transformations

An on-site inspection is also necessary to record humidity, infiltrations, deformations, cracks, and the condition of roofs or facades. Do not attribute a certain cause to a stain and do not judge structural safety based on a photograph. In case of doubt, commission a qualified professional to determine if surveys, investigations, or a structural assessment are needed.

Check separately the possibility of changing the layout, opening new doorways, intervening on installations, or changing the use of the rooms. The fact that a house is currently inhabited does not automatically prove the feasibility of your project.

## Historic centers, landscape, and the Madonie context

For every property, it is necessary to identify urban planning regulations, any cultural or landscape protections, and other relevant constraints. The Municipality of Cefalù published a notice of adoption of the provincial landscape plan in 2026: a technician must check the deeds, cartography, and requirements applicable to the specific land plot, without assuming an outcome based solely on the notice title. For properties in the Madonie, the competent authorities for that specific location are also consulted.

The reference to the Madonie does not imply that every locality has identical rules or identical operating conditions. Marenetto Build carries out work mainly within approximately 60 km of Cefalù, in the Madonie, and along the coast; projects beyond this area are evaluated upon request with a dedicated quote.

## Transforming checks into a clear request

Before asking for a quote, prepare your objectives, address, available documentation, and priorities. Distinguish between necessary works, desired works, and those still subject to verifications. Request an estimate after a site inspection, including included works, exclusions, and conditions to be clarified: not a figure that assumes documents or conditions not yet known.

You can explore our [construction services](/en/services) and write to the [official contact](mailto:info@marenetto.com). Initially, send only the necessary information; agree on an appropriate channel before sharing documents containing personal data.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is an updated cadastral floor plan enough to purchase without risks?

No. Cadastral, urban-building, mortgage, and physical checks have different purposes. The notary and the appointed technicians evaluate their respective aspects; no single document eliminates every risk.

### Does a crack mean the house is structurally unsafe?

A crack, by itself, does not allow one to diagnose a structural failure or rule it out. Evaluation and any necessary investigations are up to the qualified professional.

### Can you already provide the cost of the renovation?

The reference is a quote provided after an inspection and after having clarified the project, conditions, and any verifications still required. This guide does not contain prices or feasibility guarantees.

## Sources and limitations

Sources consulted November 25, 2026: Agenzia delle Entrate, home purchase guide, section on pre-purchase checks; Normattiva, D.P.R. 380/2001, article 9-bis; Regione Siciliana, L.R. 16/2016, consolidated text declared in force as of February 28, 2025; Municipality of Cefalù, SUE and notice on the landscape plan of July 23, 2026. URLs and update limits are in the source register. This survey is informational: it does not certify the regularity of a specific property, which remains to be verified with the assigned technician and, regarding areas of competence, with the notary.
